scope: Return-data dependency closure, not audit of unrelated implementation internals

account.meaning: Selected account balance or code, not account/storage trie root or ordered effects.
account.updates: StateDB AddBalance/SubBalance/SetBalance, SetCode and creation/selfdestruct update selected account fields. Ordinary token transfers can change unrelated storage without changing a selected balance/code. No global-root return.

addressTable.meaning: Address-to-index registry and RLP supplied-data codec, not transaction register.
addressTable.updates: Register alone appends an explicitly supplied address and increments numItems; repeat registration returns existing slot. Compress only reads lookup or encodes address (despite nonpayable ABI); Decompress decodes supplied bytes or supplied index. Size counts registrations, not transfers.

legacy.updates: No history producer. burnArbGas consumes caller-chosen gas; getStats returns current L2 number plus five zeros; aggregator defaults are BatchPosterAddress; deprecated tx base fee is zero/no-op.

l1Pricing.meaning: Pricing/configuration values and aggregate fee accounting, not an ordered commitment.
l1Pricing.updates: PricePerUnit, inertia, reward payee/rate, equilibration, batch charge, cap and floor have owner setters. unitsSinceUpdate += compressed calldata units before EVM; batch report allocates/subtracts units, adjusts rewards/refunds, update time, last surplus and price with integer arithmetic. L1FeesAvailable receives PosterFee after transaction and loses batch payments. GetL1PricingSurplus = feesAvailable - totalFundsDue - rewardDebt at v61. No transaction content, transfer log list or order hash is accumulated.

l2Pricing.meaning: Gas limits, min price, model parameters, resource backlogs and base fees.
l2Pricing.updates: EndTxHook grows active scalar/resource backlogs by gas usage, not ordered transaction bytes; retryable redeem shrinks donated-gas backlog. StartBlock decays backlogs by elapsed time and computes fees. Owner changes limits/constraints/backlogs. Current per-resource fees rotate from next before block execution; v61 SingleDim uses actual block base fee. Saturating arithmetic, weighted sums and decay discard information/order; not cryptographic commitments.

posterFee.meaning: Fee for the current top-level message only.
posterFee.updates: GasChargingHook computes PosterDataCost from message transaction/compressed calldata and configured prices, converts to posterGas and stores PosterFee. It is no receipt prefix, execution position or prior-transfer content.

posters.meaning: Poster membership and per-poster fee-recipient configuration.
posters.updates: Owner addBatchPoster or internal batch-spending report adds poster. SetFeeCollector writes PayTo after caller-role check. TotalFundsDue is an arithmetic debt sum. Enumeration bounded to 65536; no log/transaction commitment.

config.meaning: Chain configuration, membership and scheduled parameters.
config.updates: Owner changes member sets, fee accounts, flags and enable timestamps; ArbOS initializes/upgrades defaults. rectifyChainOwner is public but repairs an already-member corrupt mapping, not arbitrary admission. Membership enumeration caps at 65536. ScheduledUpgrade reads version/time, suppresses already-applied schedule. These are current configuration facts, not history commitments.

stylusParams.meaning: Stylus metering/version/lifetime configuration, no execution-history value.
stylusParams.updates: Params decodes packed fields; Save writes owner-specified parameters only when executed onchain, otherwise charges equivalent gas; init/upgrades also set fields. PageRamp is an initialized constant in Params, not live activity. ActivationGas is separate stored uint64. MinInitGas body rejects versions <32, admitted at61.

stylusProgram.meaning: Selected codehash activation/version/size/init-cost/expiry/cache metadata, not global state root.
stylusProgram.updates: Activation reads selected program codehash/Wasm, compiles it and records version, init/cached cost, footprint, estimated asm KB, activation hour and cache flag keyed by codehash. Keepalive resets activation hour and updates byte-demand fee model. Authorized cache changes only cached flag. Program getters resolve supplied address to codehash. Module hash is compiled-code identity/event data, never an executing-history accumulator.

retryable.meaning: A selected ticket, timeout/beneficiary, scheduled retry hash or current redeemer, not all transactions.
retryable.updates: Submit processing creates ticket with submitted from/to/value/data/beneficiary and lifetime. Keepalive increments timeoutWindowsLeft; reap advances/removes expired ticket; success/cancel deletes it. Redeem increments NumTries and constructs a future ArbitrumRetryTx from ticket, chainId, nonce, basefee, donated gas and refund caller; returned Hash commits that scheduled transaction only. CurrentRefundTo is set only for the active retry transaction. submitRetryable ABI always reverts when called normally.

sysContext.updates: BlockContext populated for the block; chain config/ArbOS format state determine domain/version. ArbOSVersion ABI returns 55+format. Depth, TopTxType, Origin and Contracts call stack determine alias booleans/caller. Alias mapping is a pure transform of supplied sender; unused destination ignored. No executing receipt or global root.

l2History.meaning: Completed-L2 ancestor hash, not current-block or executing-prefix root.
l2History.updates: ArbBlockHash explicitly requires n-256<=k<n and reads BlockContext.GetHash(k), backed by ancestor headers. Current transaction/receipt trie roots assembled in NewBlock after execution; header.Root finalized using IntermediateRoot. No current-prefix root exposed.

outbox.meaning: L2-to-L1 send sequence only, excluding arbitrary ordinary ERC20 transfers.
outbox.updates: sendTxToL1 hashes caller,destination,L2/L1 numbers,time,value and supplied data, then Append hashes leaf, increments size and folds partials. Returns new leaf index at61, not root. withdrawEth calls same with empty bytes. export root/size/partials is zero-caller-only; even if accessible it commits sends only, not preceding arbitrary transfers.

internal.meaning: Explorer-facing internal ABI always rejects ordinary calls.
internal.updates: Handlers always CallerNotArbOS, including a nominal ordinary caller equal to system address. Protocol processing intercepts actual ArbitrumInternalTx and executes startBlock/batch reports outside these handlers. StartBlock writes preceding hash and updates pricing/reaping/upgrades; no current prefix getter.

nativeToken.meaning: Role-restricted mint/burn of caller native balance, no commitment output.
nativeToken.updates: hasAccess checks NativeTokenOwners membership, then AddBalance/SubBalance(caller, supplied amount) and event. Feature timestamp gates admitting new role members, not a substitute for membership at mint/burn.

filter.meaning: Membership of a caller-supplied tx hash in a mutable privileged filter list.
filter.updates: Add stores hash=>1 and Delete clears after TransactionFilterers check; IsTransactionFiltered is PUBLIC, wrapper only varies gas charging. DeleteFree is a defined cleanup entrypoint. Does not authenticate inclusion, order, execution or complete prefix; arbitrary hash can be listed before execution.

owner.meaning: All 60 methods behind chain-owner wrapper, including view methods.
owner.updates: Caller must be current ChainOwners member. Mutation parameters are owner supplied; releaseL1PricerSurplusFunds returns min(max, poolBalance-recognizedFees) and credits feesAvailable. Other reads expose configuration/membership. No ordinary Migration authority or full executing-prefix output.

debug.meaning: Debug-config-only mutators/events/errors, not admitted on advertised production configuration.
debug.updates: Requires ChainConfig.DebugMode; inherited official chain config says false, not attested runtime config. Methods return supplied paid/flag/caller, old selected code, or errors; BecomeChainOwner and Overwrite mutate only when debug enabled. No prefix producer even in debug.
